item.tib: lha srung spyi yi mnga' gsol bde legs kun 'byung
item.coloph: ces lha dang srung ma spyi yi mnga' gsol bde legs kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad ldan grogs po'i bka'i (bkas) bskul ba'i ngor rmi lam dag pa'i snang ba cung la brten nas/ thun mong zhes pa'i lcags pho khyi yi hor zla nyer gnyis tshes la/ thos chung mu la bdag gis bla brang sku rim mkho skabs su/ dar rgyas gling gi lha khang byin rlabs dngos 'bebs su sug bris bgyis pa yi/ bstan dang sems can gyi don chen po 'grub par gyur cig/
